Editorial policy

Accuracy over completeness

We would rather a page say "check the service sheet inside the machine for the resistance value" than print a number we are not certain of. Specific figures, part numbers and torque settings are only stated where they are verifiable, and pages are explicit about model-series variation where it exists.

Safety

Any procedure touching mains wiring, a gas connection or a sealed refrigerant circuit is marked and handed to a qualified technician. We do not publish workarounds that defeat a door interlock, a thermal cut-out or any other safety device, no matter how often they are asked about.

Commercial relationships

Pages may link to parts retailers and to repair services, and those links may earn a commission. This never changes the diagnosis. If the likeliest cause of your code is a blocked filter you can clear in ten minutes with no parts, that is what the page says, because a page that sells you a pump you did not need is a page nobody comes back to.

Trademarks

Samsung, LG, Whirlpool, Bosch, GE, Maytag, KitchenAid, Frigidaire, Kenmore, Miele and other brand names are the property of their respective owners. This site is independent and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or authorised by any appliance manufacturer. Brand names are used only to identify the appliances the guidance applies to.
